107 (
108  ADCBuf_Handle adcBufHandle,

111  uint32_t chanDataSize,

114 )
115 {
116  ADCBuf_dataFormat dataFormat __attribute__((aligned(32)));
117  ADCBuf_RxChanConf rxChanConf __attribute__((aligned(32)));
118  int32_t retVal = 0U;
119  uint8_t channel;
120  uint32_t rxChanMask __attribute__((aligned(32))) = 0xF;
121  int32_t rxChanOffsetIndx = 0;
122 
123  /* ADCBuf requires argument pointer at 4bytes boundary*/
124  uint32_t chirpThresholdVal __attribute__((aligned(32))) = chirpThreshold;
125 
126  /*****************************************************************************
127  * Data path :: ADCBUF driver Configuration
128  *****************************************************************************/
129  /* Populate data format from configuration */
130  dataFormat.adcOutFormat = adcBufCfg->adcFmt;
131  dataFormat.channelInterleave = adcBufCfg->chInterleave;
132  dataFormat.sampleInterleave = adcBufCfg->iqSwapSel;
133 
134  /* Disable all ADCBuf channels */
135  if ((retVal = ADCBuf_control(adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_CHANNEL_DISABLE, (void *)&rxChanMask)) < 0)
136  {
137 #ifdef MMWDEMO_CONFIGADCBUF_DBG
138  System_printf("Error: Disable ADCBuf channels failed with [Error=%d]\n", retVal);
139 #endif
140  goto exit;
141  }
142 
143  retVal = ADCBuf_control(adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_CONF_DATA_FORMAT, (void *)&dataFormat);
144  if (retVal < 0)
145  {
146  goto exit;
147  }
148 
149  memset((void*)&rxChanConf, 0, sizeof(ADCBuf_RxChanConf));
150 
151  /* Enable Rx Channels */
152  for (channel = 0; channel < SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; channel++)
153  {
154  if(rxChannelEn & (0x1U << channel))
155  {
156  /* Populate the receive channel configuration: */
157  rxChanConf.channel = channel;
158  retVal = ADCBuf_control(adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_CHANNEL_ENABLE, (void *)&rxChanConf);
159  if (retVal < 0)
160  {
161 #ifdef MMWDEMO_CONFIGADCBUF_DBG
162  System_printf("Error: MMWDemoDSS ADCBuf Control for Channel %d Failed with error[%d]\n", channel, retVal);
163 #endif
164  goto exit;
165  }
166  /* Offset starts from 0 for the first channel */
167  rxChanOffset[rxChanOffsetIndx++] = rxChanConf.offset;
168 
169  /* Calculate offset for the next channel */
170  rxChanConf.offset += chanDataSize * chirpThresholdVal;
171  }
172  }
173 
174  /* Set ping/pong chirp threshold: */
175  retVal = ADCBuf_control(adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_SET_PING_CHIRP_THRESHHOLD,
176  (void *)&chirpThresholdVal);
177  if(retVal < 0)
178  {
179 #ifdef MMWDEMO_CONFIGADCBUF_DBG
180  System_printf("Error: ADCbuf Ping Chirp Threshold Failed with Error[%d]\n", retVal);
181 #endif
182  goto exit;
183  }
184  retVal = ADCBuf_control(adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_SET_PONG_CHIRP_THRESHHOLD,
185  (void *)&chirpThresholdVal);
186  if(retVal < 0)
187  {
188 #ifdef MMWDEMO_CONFIGADCBUF_DBG
189  System_printf("Error: ADCbuf Pong Chirp Threshold Failed with Error[%d]\n", retVal);
190 #endif
191  goto exit;
192  }
193 
194 exit:
195  return (retVal);
196 }
